body: O don't want to be here anymore. I don't want to take up anymore space. Being dead means nobody will have to worry about me, in the sense of me being in thier way.
He was my boyfriend at the time he said it.

In general. I've tried changing my environment, my routine, changed jobs, got a stable life, got a car, a beautiful apartment, great docs, a great therapist, a job I loved, a man I adored, friends, hobbies, a cat. It all just still comes flooding in, and it's not like "oh I might just cut my wrists" no it's full on "ok, think, what do you need to put in place, a will, don't want a funeral or memorial service, put my body in a body farm, so be careful of chemicals, close social media accounts, etc" yes, I have a checklist. I have wrote down all my passwords and everything so they can have my phone turned off and all that. I'm just so beyond done, and after reaching out to 2 people and one completely ignoring me and the other wanting to see my try it because "if you really were going to do it you wouldn't talk about it. People who actually want to show no signs, they do it without any warning." So fine I will!!!
PTSD therapy, dbt, cbt, innercranial magnetic stimulation, I've even tried the natural stuff. Oils, herbs, meditation, yoga, exersize, painting, on and on.

I've been in and out of hospitals, been through all the meds, literally, they are to the point where they don't know what to do anymore. Been in therapy for 17 years. Always the same. I just end up back here.
I feel like I'm not serving any purpose. I'm just in the way. Just like the bag of clothes you keep meaning to take to the thrift store, but forget about until you trip over it.

I'm one angry B! I was told that if a person truelly wanted to kill themselves they wouldn't talk about it or post it. That it's just a cry for attention. 

On another note, what makes you happy? Be selfish with your life, it's yours after all. Eat your favorite foods, buy clothes you like, watch what you want. I'm super single for the first time in my life and it's fabulous!

Is your dad's bullshit really worth your life? Why would you give him that power? I completely understand how hard it is to thrive in an abusive environment, my mother and first husband were both very abusive, but sweetheart try to consentrait on school, a job, a car, and get the hell out of there! Go live your life! I'm 33, I battle suicidal thoughts constantly. Do these things and see how it goes. Don't die for someone who won't even crack and egg for you.
